data.body: ENFORCE-FLIP GATE ADDITION P8c (canonical panel, 2026-06-04): override-propagation must reach the PROVENANCE consumer (verify-session-provenance -> llm-review dispatch), not just coverage-invariant — else under enforce EVERY FP-recovery is a guaranteed DOUBLE-wedge (review-sub-pr on PR1 + llm-review re-review on PR2; proven live on #634). P8c = 3ebb DD4 unit 5 landed AND its 5 HARD SECURITY CONDITIONS met (C1 code-enforced opus-gate in fp-recovery-record-exemption.sh; C2 honor only exempt_by=fp-recovery; C3 closure-key boundary as a control + key-independent backstop or authorizing ADR; C4 no-dormant P-AEL-PROVENANCE predicate; C5 staged-* not force-review). CRITICAL SEQUENCING: provisioning the closure-key to CI (G-A / P8b) arms BOTH the coverage AND provenance ledger consults simultaneously, so G-A MUST be gated on C1-C3 — do NOT provision the key until the opus-gate is code-enforced, or it opens signed self-laundering past llm-review.
